about.mission: To build a strong bond with organisations wanting to build a support system and improve their present structure by providing them with perpetual consultancy and recruitment of staff or labour, be it permanent, contractual, skilled or unskilled.
about.vision: To be the best security consultant and employee management partner as a way of life in business organisations and industries.
about.description:
Knight Eyes Security Services was founded 10 years ago to provide the best corporate service in its field, specializing in manpower services (both skilled and unskilled), security services, PSO housekeeping services to public and professional sectors. Your premises are now safe and secured with up-to-date security personnel.

Knight Eyes Security Services is a distinguished provider of security solutions and housekeeping services, catering to prominent Blue Chip and Public Sector companies, including Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd in the government sector, Central Railway Hospital in Pune, and Amanora Park Town — known for its world-class facilities and falling under the Government of Maharashtra's Special Township Policy.

The helm of Knight Eyes Security Services is expertly guided by our dynamic Chairman, Mr. Mahesh Doke, a well-established entrepreneur in the field of security and housekeeping services, recognized as a significant player in the landscaping domain in Maharashtra over the past five years. The Board of Directors boasts the esteemed presence of Retired Major Namdev Bhanudas Doke, whose distinguished service to the nation in various capacities and command of diverse formations has resulted in a commendable track record.
about.motto: Without threat there is no need of security, but remember — with security there is no threat.

training.intro: Through our various training programs, we prepare our personnel to be more capable and updated security personnel to establish and maintain a disciplined and committed organization. Ex-servicemen (retired from the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force) are associated with us for better training-related guidance.
programme: Basic training for security personnel (punctuality, alertness, behavior, discipline)
broadAims: Teach basic etiquette and manners to be followed in the workplace.
Prepare the guards to be mentally robust and physically tough so as to enable them to perform strenuous security duty for up to 12 hours.
Prepare the trainee guards to handle emergencies without panic.
Train the guards in Fire Response and First Aid.
Inculcate a sense of discipline and team spirit.
